fields.name: Index
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18A9610 renumbers the pending requests 0..n-1 by writing the loop counter at +0 of every 0x238-byte element; bg3.exe+0x18AC420 copies it into the result record.

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18AC420 uses the byte at +4 as the key of a HashMap<uint8_t, Array<0x68-byte rule>> (hash = value % size, keys compared as bytes).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: NOT decoded. An object destroyed by bg3.exe+0x18856E0 starts at +8. Known inside it: +0x1E8 and +0x1F8 are two condition/tag blocks passed to a virtual call (slot 2 of the object at system + 0x58) and guarded by bool flags at +0x1F4 and +0x204 (bg3.exe+0x18AB4F0).

fields.name: RequestIndex
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x18A9610 copies it from +0x18 of the system's 0x20-byte match record, which bg3.exe+0x18AC420 fills with TimelineThothRunRequest::Index.

fields.name: Id
fields.evidence: 16 bytes copied from +0 of the match record = the first 16 bytes of the matching 0x68-byte rule (bg3.exe+0x18AC420); bg3.exe+0x18AC5A0 evaluates the rule's condition at +0x14.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x18AD230 zeroes three arrays; destructor bg3.exe+0x18884B0 destroys elements of +0x00 and +0x10 with bg3.exe+0x1889320. bg3.exe+0x18A9610 (ecl::timeline::ArenaDecisionSystem update; registration bg3.exe+0x7466C0, callback bg3.exe+0x761A70) swaps the system's pending array (system + 0x70, stride 0x238) into +0x00 (bg3.exe+0x18ACBD0) and then walks +0x00 with stride 0x238, size at +0x0C.

fields.name: PreviousRequests
fields.evidence: Same function: the second bg3.exe+0x18ACBD0 call swaps the array that was in +0x00 into +0x10 through a local; the old +0x10 contents are destroyed with stride 0x238.

fields.name: Results
fields.evidence: Same function: size at +0x2C reset to 0 every frame, then one 0x18-byte element appended (grow helper bg3.exe+0x5C4B00) per match record of the system (system + 0x80, stride 0x20, sorted first).

fields.name: Seed
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x18AD230 stores the result of rand() at +0x30 and the same value at +0x34. Probe: 0x2CD6 in both.

fields.name: InitialSeed
fields.evidence: See Seed; which of the two advances was not established (both equal in the probe).

open_questions: TimelineThothRunRequest is 0x238 bytes and only its first 5 bytes are decoded; field_8 is a placeholder (its bytes ARE read by the game). Expose the array as hidden or decode the element before using it.
Names Seed / InitialSeed: two copies of one rand() value; their separate roles are unknown.
What the Guid in the result identifies (the selected rule / combat-camera shot of the cinematic arena) was not established.
Probe: all three arrays null/empty outside combat.
